Dining cruises with fresh food prepared daily and live entertainment
Sunset Cocktail Cruise is for guests age 19 and older

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Kingston’s food, fun and entertainment ships are available for private charter. Captivate your guests with history, ambiance, landscape and location aboard an exclusive, chartered cruise in Kingston and the 1000 Islands. Our vessels, the ‘Island Belle,’ ‘Island Star’ and ‘Island Queen,’ make a unique event or wedding venue and an unforgettable experience. Your event coordinator will work together with you to design a combination of charter rate, dining and additional services to match your vision. Rates vary depending on season and sailing time. includes: Three-course dinner on Sunset Dinner Cruise
Salad, entrée, and dessert on Islands Lunch Cruise
gap: Prices for individual cruises not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy sightseeing cruises ranging from 1 to 3 hours exploring Kingston's waterfront and the 1000 Islands. Dining cruises offer brunch, lunch, or dinner with fresh food prepared daily and live entertainment. Group and private charters are available for larger parties and special events.
extraNote: Ticket Assurance refundable up to 3 hours before cruise or tour boarding time, costs $10 per guest for cruises · Priority Boarding available for $5 per guest between Victoria Day and Thanksgiving weekend · Group reservations require initial deposit at booking and full payment 4 days prior to departure · Group reservations must be made at least 48 hours prior to departure to receive preferred rate · Dock located at 1 Brock St. Kingston, Ontario · April to October
